messages.author: af25fc7ce08ea1c7
messages.subject: Legend Labeling
parts:
Hi,

usually ggplot automatically gives the legend the name of the colours-
variable in aes(x,y, colours=variable).

Is there a function to give the legend an independent lable ?

Greetz,

Ed

messages.author: e4aec126ff1dca22
messages.subject: Re: Legend Labeling
parts:
Take a look at scale_colour_discrete :

a <- 1:50; b <- 1:50; c <- factor(rep(1:2, each = 25))
qplot(a, b, geom = 'point', colour = c) + 
  scale_colour_discrete('Title', labels = c('One','Two'))

best
david.

messages.author: e4aec126ff1dca22
messages.subject: Re: Legend Labeling
parts:
Try xlab and ylab :

a <- factor(1:50)
b <- factor(1:50)

c <- factor(rep(1:2, each = 25))
qplot(a, b, geom = 'point', colour = c) +

scale_colour_discrete('Title', labels = c('One','Two')) +
  xlab('x axis') + ylab('y axis')

Cheers
david
